# Tokyo Trip Guide

> > Comprehensive Tokyo travel resource covering accommodations, itineraries, navigation, and practical guides for every budget and travel style.

Tokyo Trip Guide helps travelers navigate Japan's capital with detailed guides on transportation, neighborhoods like Shinjuku and Shibuya, budget-saving tips, and curated itineraries for couples, families, and solo adventurers. The site features hotel recommendations, attraction guides, and practical advice for dining, payments, and getting around Tokyo efficiently.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo neighborhoods (Shinjuku, Shibuya, Asakusa, Ginza)
- Budget travel strategies and discount coupons
- Luxury hotels and accommodations
- Self-guided walking tours and free attractions
- Tokyo Station navigation
- Digital payments (PayPay, QR codes)
- Family-friendly itineraries
- Couples and romantic experiences
- Late-night transportation
- Michelin dining
- Booking platforms (Klook, Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com)
- Summer heat survival tips
- English-speaking healthcare services
- Tokyo Metro passes

## Essential Navigation & Transportation

- [Tokyo Station Made Simple: Master Japan's Busiest Hub](https://tripguide.tokyo/tokyo-station-navigation-guide): Navigation guide for Tokyo Station's Marunouchi & Yaesu exits
- [Late Night Transportation in Tokyo: Getting Around After Midnight](https://tripguide.tokyo/tokyo-late-night-transportation-guide): After-midnight transport options when Tokyo trains stop running

## Budget Travel & Money-Saving Guides

- [Tokyo Free Walking Tour Routes: Self-Guided Budget Adventures](https://tripguide.tokyo/tokyo-free-walking-tour-routes-budget-guide): Self-guided walking routes through Asakusa, Sensoji & Shibuya Crossing
- [Tokyo Discount Coupon Guide: Where to Find Tourist Savings](https://tripguide.tokyo/tokyo-tourist-discount-coupon-guide-savings): Tourist discount coupons via Klook, GetYourGuide & metro passes
- [Tokyo QR Code Culture: Digital Payments & Menus Made Simple](https://tripguide.tokyo/tokyo-qr-code-culture-digital-payments-menus): Guide to PayPay QR payments & digital menus in Tokyo restaurants

## Curated Itineraries

- [3-Day Luxury Tokyo Escape: A Romantic Couple's Guide](https://tripguide.tokyo/itinerary/3-day-luxury-tokyo-escape-for-couples): 3-day luxury couples itinerary with Michelin dining & romantic spots
- [Tokyo Family Luxury: 5-Day Itinerary with Kids](https://tripguide.tokyo/itinerary/5-day-tokyo-luxury-kid-friendly-itinerary): 5-day family itinerary with Disneyland, TeamLab & kid-friendly dining

## Accommodations

- [Complete Tokyo Accommodations List](https://tripguide.tokyo/accommodations): Complete Tokyo hotels archive by neighborhood & price across city
- [Conrad Tokyo](https://tripguide.tokyo/stay/conrad-tokyo): 5-star Conrad Tokyo hotel in Minato near Shiodome & Ginza
- [The Capitol Hotel Tokyu](https://tripguide.tokyo/stay/the-capitol-hotel-tokyu): Luxury Capitol Hotel Tokyu in Akasaka with Japanese hospitality
- [Hilton Tokyo](https://tripguide.tokyo/stay/hilton-tokyo): 5-star Hilton in Nishi-Shinjuku with pool & family amenities
- [Courtyard by Marriott Tokyo Station](https://tripguide.tokyo/stay/courtyard-by-marriott-tokyo-station): 4-star Marriott in Kyobashi near Tokyo Station & Ginza

## Attractions & Sightseeing

- [Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building Observatory](https://tripguide.tokyo/attraction/tokyo-metropolitan-government-building): Free Shinjuku observatory with Mt. Fuji views by Kenzo Tange
- [Tokyo Budget-Level Options](https://tripguide.tokyo/budget-level/moderate): Moderate budget attractions & dining including Akihabara maid cafes

## Practical Travel Tips

- [Tokyo Summer Survival Guide: Beating the Heat & Humidity Like a Local](https://tripguide.tokyo/tokyo-summer-heat-survival-guide): Local tactics for surviving Tokyo's summer heat & humidity
- [Tokyo Healthcare for Travelers: Hospitals & Travel Insurance](https://tripguide.tokyo/tokyo-healthcare-travelers-hospitals-insurance): English-speaking hospitals in Azabu, Hiroo & Roppongi for travelers
